metabolic_screening.declination_law: Code of Virginia â newborn screening mandated; religious exemption recognized; parent/guardian refusal documented via VDH Notification of Parental Refusal form.

hearing_screening.opt_out_form_label: Notification of Parental Refusal (covers hearing screening component)
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Same Notification of Parental Refusal form covers hearing screening refusal. Virginia's newborn screening includes blood spot, CCHD, and hearing components.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents; if objection, ensure signed Notification of Parental Refusal form is completed and sent to VDH.
